3 Months Free Payroll — Spring Promo is Live

The Spring Payroll Promo goes live May 11 for net-new customers and rolls out to existing customers May 18. Offer ends July 15, 2026. Auto-applied at signup — no manual action needed except for exception-based existing customers in the gap week.

In-app banner — "Run payroll for $0. Get 3 months free when you process payroll by July 15."
📄 Spring Payroll Promo — Sales One-Pager (click to expand)

Rollout · Week of May 11

Cash Out Now Accepts Discover Cards

We were previously blocking Discover Debit — the primary card issuer for Capital One Bank — which was costing us roughly 620 new Cash Out enrollments every month. That block is being lifted this week. Web enrollment rolling out now (QA wrapping); SMS invites going out next week.

▶ Open the Cash Out Simulator
🔓
What changed: Discover debit cards (primary issuer for Capital One Bank) are no longer blocked at Cash Out enrollment. ~620 enrollments/month previously rejected will now go through.
📅
Rollout timing: Web enrollment rolling out the week of May 11 — QA wrap this week. SMS invites going out next week.
📱
How EEs get to Cash Out: Initial SMS invites go to employees with phone numbers on profile. Timeclock locations get a QR code.
🧪
Demo it: The Cash Out simulator lets you walk the full flow without real banking info. Great for handling EE questions or showing owners what their team experiences.
Talk track: "Cash Out works with virtually every debit card now — including Discover, which we'd been blocking. If your team has any Capital One cardholders, they'll be able to enroll starting this week." Use this to answer "how does my team sign up?" and "what cards work?" Initial SMS invite goes to EEs with phone numbers on profile; Timeclock locations get a QR.

New Feature · Now Live

New Hire Packet — "Overdue" Logic Now Live

The employee-side onboarding card now flips to "Overdue" once an EE's start date passes without their NHP being complete. Overdue is determined by the EE's start date — not the invite date. No employer notifications yet; no penalty to EE usage.

▶ Watch the 2:26 Loom walkthrough
EE dashboard states → "Start onboarding" · "Continue" · "Overdue"
1
Before start date
"Your first day is [Mar 31] 🎉" — card shows Start onboarding CTA. Progress bar at 0/7.
2
After start, in progress
"Complete your onboarding 🎉" with days left countdown + a Continue CTA. Progress bar shows current step (e.g. 4/7).
3
Past start, incomplete
Card flips to Overdue pill + Complete now CTA. Driven by start date, not invite date.
The 7-step NHP checklist as the EE sees it
📅
Overdue is start-date based: The card flips to Overdue only after the EE's start date passes without completion. Invite date is not a factor.
🔕
No ER notifications yet: Employers are not pinged when an EE goes overdue. This is internal-only visibility for now.
✅
No penalty to the EE: They can still complete every step normally — the pill is informational, not blocking.
⏱️
Visibility window under discussion: The team is considering limiting the Overdue state to ~2 weeks before changing or removing it.
Owner-facing talking point: If an owner asks "why does my new hire's app say overdue?" — explain the card is start-date based, no notifications fire, the employee can still complete normally, and the visibility window may tighten over time.

📊 RevOps / Sales
Beta Wrap · Wider Launch Next Week

Blitz Mode Beta Wrapping — Broader Launch Next Week

The Trailblazer team's beta of Blitz Mode in the GTM OS workspace is wrapping this week, with broader rollout to sales next week. Training day and time are TBD — RevOps will confirm soon.

Blitz Mode → GTM OS Workspace · Account, talk track, and next-best-action in one view
🧭
Account context up front: Summary, employees, locations, current payroll, POS, HB age, business type, timezone — all rendered as soon as the account loads.
💬
Tailored talk tracks per play: Opening + branching positive/negative responses + transition + 3 discovery questions, all surfaced inline. First-Time Buyer, Switcher, and other plays each have their own track.
⚡
Cadence actions in one row: Call Now, Create Opp, Follow Up, Skip, DQ — no tab juggling between Salesforce, Talkdesk, and notes.
📝
Notes & Activity rail: Lives on the right side of every account — Notes / Activity / Messages tabs in one place, no Salesforce tab switching.
📅
Training day TBD: RevOps will share scheduling, the full training deck, and the cadence Blitz Mode is initially tuned for in next week's comms.
For Trailblazer team members: You already have the training deck. For everyone else — watch for the broader scheduling note next week.
